laws.name: THE STAGING LAW

The requirement's kind (`existing` — a document sent as it is · `new_work` — new or revised content still to be produced, even INTO an existing document) is a reasoned field judged in the same pick that matches the file (a kind the judge's inventory states wins); the dates are code-checked against the REQUEST message (a commitment's source email): the file's effective date is the EARLIEST it can be (its own name's date, when we first saw it, its conversation's date). New work is never satisfied by a file from on or before the request — that file is offered as the BASE (staged as context under `base:<label>`, never `require:`), the requirement stays an ask/produce; an older file satisfies an existing-artifact ask only when the request names it. A resolver-staged row the law now refuses is unstaged through ONE writer (the pointer row goes, the user's file is never touched, the reason is recorded), and only on a positive demotion — an AI outage never unstages. W13.2: the law is VERSIONED and heals itself — the platform, never an operator. Every resolver-staged `require:` row carries the staging-law version it was verified under (`metadata.stagingLaw`, no migration); a row stamped with an older law, or unstamped, is never read as settled and is re-verified by THE ONE RESOLVER on its next touch (the prepare pass before its lanes, the judge's serving edge, the draft doors): its FILE is put first in the same reasoned pick (the kind rides that call), and the ruling is code's — the same file verified restamps in place (not new supply), another file replaces it, a demotion or a stale row the pick cleanly does not verify is unstaged through the one writer, and an unanswered pick holds (the row stands, still stale, still read as staged — an AI failure never unstages). Bounded: REVERIFY_PER_PASS items per pass (the rest counted and said), one item per open. The repair script is an optional accelerator that calls the same function. W13.6: the base is OFFERED, never lost — for new work the document the content goes into is the reasoned match (code then makes an older one the base), a stale row the current pick cannot verify on a new-work requirement becomes the base when the request names its older file, and the room's ask names it ("Current version (to update): <file>"). A clause with no subject, a subordinate clause or disagreeing clauses change nothing. On a mail where the user only sits in CC and is not named, the sender’s own promise is made to the To: party and mints nothing (the seat law’s sibling). THE QUOTE SEPARATES: a mail’s asks quoted from different sentences or list lines never merge in the G1 consolidation (each keeps its own due and its own done); the meeting path keeps its reasoned check. AN EXPLICIT OFFICE KIND BEATS THE WORD TRIGGER
laws.statement: Every file the product hands a user (a DM or delegated document, a workflow deliverable or its e-mail attachment, a compute output, a frame) opens as the format its name and MIME declare, carries the structure that was asked (headings as real heading styles, the sheet's columns, the deck's slides), states only figures that are raw values of its source or computed by code from it, and carries words, not syntax (no literal markdown, no character-art charts, no undefined/NaN/[object Object]). Mechanisms: an explicit office kind (the author's typed fence, a forced spreadsheet/presentation) beats the frame words; a builder always receives the shape it reads (docToSheets/docToSlides, else an honest document); character art is stripped at the door (stripCharacterArt); the compiler's validation runs the text-hygiene gate (officeHygieneProblems) beside the render gate; tabular material in a DM is shown to the author and aggregated in the sandbox first (tabularBlock + computeDataFacts); compute outputs carry their extension's MIME (outputMime); the served name comes from the stored bytes' extension and keeps the title's letters (downloadHeaders); an e-mail attachment is the stored delivered file (attachmentForArtifact).

gates.note: W38 (uncommitted): tests/unit/generated-files — the code checker (numbers, formulas, language, garbage, format), downloadHeaders, attachment shape checks, docToSheets/docToSlides, stripCharacterArt, tabularBlock, textHygieneProblems, outputMime, and the door's explicit-kind/shape cases called for real (theme null, zero AI). Measured live by scripts/verify-generated-files.ts (12 producers × both tiers on probe #3: real models, the real sandbox and bucket, every stored file opened and judged in code — zero judge; once per wave, ~€0.3/tier).

laws.note: Found by the W38 live verifier (Oct 1): an Excel 'tracker' ask and a typed sheet titled 'tracker' shipped as .html frames; a forced sheet/deck over markdown threw in the builder (no file); the workflow e-mail re-rendered the attachment by the CONFIGURED kind (a sheet fed to the Word builder threw; compiled charts were lost); compute .xlsx/.docx outputs were stored as application/octet-stream and skipped by the KB indexer; computeDataFacts' 900-token codegen truncated every script (facts silently null product-wide); a DM deck stated quarter totals +5,000 and a 29,600 year total (true 13,600); a compiled .docx carried literal **bold**, an ASCII bar chart and no heading styles; served filenames lost every accented letter and DM titles were mid-word slices of the ask. The compiler's one reasoned repair was blind: it carried the HEAD of stderr (a screen of Fontconfig cache warnings), never the exception. Indexing a delivered file snowballed 'AUGMTD Files' sources: after one race left two rows, .maybeSingle() errored (ignored) and every later index inserted another (64 on one real account — census only, not swept).

laws.name: THE READER IS YOU
laws.statement: A model-authored line the app serves to its reader (a workflow's description) speaks TO them in the second person — "your documents", never "the user's documents": the builder prompt asks for it and a code floor enforces it where the description is written and where it is served.

gates.note: toReaderVoice rewrites the builder's third person; wired at write and serve

collides_with.precedence: voice only — the floor rewrites who is addressed, never what is claimed

laws.name: ACTIVE MEANS ALIVE
laws.statement: A list headed active carries only live work (needs you · waiting · running); a delivered run leaves it the moment it delivers — a fresh delivery is news said once in its own quiet line, never counted or listed as active.

gates.note: the active strip filters to ACTIVE_STATES; the delivered count is its own line outside it

collides_with.precedence: the state word stays the derivation's (processStateOf); this law only decides which states an ACTIVE list may carry

laws.name: ONE RECEIPT PER DEED
laws.statement: A deed is acknowledged once, where the reader is looking, in words that say what happened: a card that turns into its own receipt is not echoed by a toast (creating a workflow says it is live once), and a typed or attached answer reads "Answer added — the run continued", never "Sent" (the send word belongs to mail that left).

gates.note: GATE_OUTCOME_WORDS.supplied says the answer was added; no answer surface says Sent; the draft card raises no live toast

collides_with.precedence: a receipt never claims an external send that did not happen — the send word is reserved for the commit door's own deeds
